name: DST WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship (WISE-PDF)
funder: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India
amount: Rs 55,000/month + Rs 2 lakh/year research grant + up to Rs 3 lakh for small equipment + overhead and HRA per DST norms
other_rules: PhD in basic or applied science or MD/MS/MDS
no regular employment (temporary researchers must leave their post if approved)
notes: Open throughout the year. Women with career breaks are encouraged to apply. Details from the ISTI summary because the DST page did not load.
